description_en: Queries the statistics on HTTP status codes of a website within a specified period
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内网站业务的各类响应状态码的统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-status-code-count --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --start-time 1582992000 --end-time 1583683200 --domain www.aliyun.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainStatusCodeCount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. The value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website to query. If you leave this parameter unspecified, the statistics on all domain names are queried.

> The domain name must be protected by Anti-DDoS Proxy. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names that are protected by Anti-DDoS Proxy
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的网站业务的域名。不设置该参数表示查询所有域名的数据。

> 域名必须已接入DDoS高防进行防护。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已接入DDoS高防的域名
parameters.name: domain
